feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED. The candidate covers exactly the three declared propositions with matching names, one `env`-only parameter each, and expression-only bodies. `door_open` scans the grid with the required `cell is not None` guard before reading `cell.type` and `cell.is_open`, and since the environment has exactly one door, 'any door cell with is_open' correctly implements 'the locked door is currently open' (including turning false when the door is toggled shut). `has_door_key` reads only the current observation, guards on `env.carrying is not None` before reading its attributes, and matches the carried key's color against the actual door color found in the grid rather than assuming a fixed color, matching 'carries a key whose color equals the door's color'. `target_picked_up` guards on `env.carrying is not None`, requires the carried object to be a box, and ties it to the mission via `env.mission == f'pick up the {env.carrying.color} box'`, so the designated target comes from the mission and no color is hardcoded; with only one box in the environment this equals 'carrying the mission's designated box'. Only documented API surfaces (`env.grid.get`, `env.carrying`, `env.mission`, `env.width`, `env.height`, object attributes `type`, `color`, `is_open`) and allowed builtins (`any`, `range`) are used; there is no mutation, no use of state descriptions, no previous-valuation access (correct, since all three propositions are persistent conditions), and `key_lost` is correctly omitted because it is not in Declared propositions and the machine does not use it.
